lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Web (1) to end plate (3), ~90 deg rounded fold. Sections at 25/50/75% show the line sitting on the outer arc apex: the nearest surface point is 0.05-0.18 mm away and the inner skin is about 3.8 mm inward. The line runs from about t=39 to 96 along a fold that spans about 36-99, and the ends are the corner relief zones. Parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Web (1) to +y side flange (5), ~90 deg, flange about 16 mm. On the outer apex at 25/50/75% (nearest point 0.02-0.13 mm). It covers the full 121 mm web edge, from the far web end to the corner relief. Parallel.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Web (1) to -y side flange (6), ~90 deg, a mirror of B2. On the outer apex (nearest point 0.02-0.13 mm), with continuous support along the whole 121.6 mm and the histogram flat over [0, L]. Parallel.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: End plate (3) to +y side flange (5), ~90 deg, flange about 14 mm. On the outer apex (nearest point 0.00-0.07 mm). It runs from the corner relief to the relief notch at the flange end (about t=63.5). The points beyond the line end belong to the end-plate perimeter above the notch, not to a fold.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: End plate (3) to -y side flange (6), ~90 deg, a mirror of B4. On the outer apex (nearest point 0.04-0.15 mm). It runs from the corner relief to the relief notch (t about 0-63.5). Parallel.
